name: Wakamatsu Minamo
source: [url=/c27025]Aine's[/url] classmate who is often absent from school and has a weak presence. [spoiler]She is actually an entertainer who spends most of her time working, but she keeps this a secret from the school. In the past, her mother was a singer, and Minamo was influenced by her.[/spoiler]
